mentions.name: Understand-Anything
mentions.description: This AI-powered tool teaches users how to understand something, helping beginners figure out what questions to ask AI in areas they are not familiar with.
mentions.problem: Beginners in unfamiliar areas often do not know what questions to ask AI.
mentions.audience: As a beginner in many areas who doesn't know what questions to ask AI when unfamiliar with a topic.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Understand-Anything, trying to use AI to teach you how to understand something.
